title: Glide 内存缓存架构：LruCache、BitmapPool 与生命周期
key_conclusions: Glide memory analysis must distinguish ActiveResources, MemoryCache, BitmapPool, DecodeJob, Transform, and RequestManager lifecycle roles.
A stable memory plateau can be an intentional cache policy, while linear growth after navigation is more likely a lifecycle leak or cache-key explosion.
BitmapPool reduces repeated native pixel allocations only when size, config, mutability, and lifecycle constraints match.
Validation needs HPROF retained paths plus meminfo Java Heap, Native Heap, Graphics, cache plateau, and decode peak evidence.
shallow_points: The article does not include real Glide internal metrics, HPROF retained paths, or meminfo timelines.
It does not validate current Glide source internals and configuration APIs against a specific Glide version.
It does not include runnable RecyclerView or image feed samples with cache, pool, transform, and lifecycle variants.
It does not compare Glide behavior with Coil or Picasso.
